title: Desktop slide test reads download constants the download page no longer has
body: openagents-desktop `slide_embeds::tests::the_download_card_matches_the_page` fails on main: `slide_embeds::download()` parses `MAC_VERSION`, `TERMINAL_VERSION`, `TERMINAL_SH` and `TERMINAL_PS1` from `crates/openagents-web/src/pages/download.rs`, but 0a15818d70 ("Show only Coder downloads on the download page") removed those constants. Point the download slide at the page's current content (CODER_VERSION and the Coder files) or drop the Mac/Terminal card, and update the test.
